kind: Browser-only diagnostic; not a native app or release gate result

method.timing: Trusted CDP keyboard input through the real native HTML textarea; keydown/input to two normal animation frames and metadata/driver/peer render barriers. Submitted frames, not physical display presentation.
method.memory: Chrome-owned task footprint charges and Rust host task charges separately. Sum of task charges is not exact aggregate physical RAM; ps RSS includes shared mappings. vmmap task snapshots are sequential. Heap snapshots remain natural through all input/open/close phases; explicit GC is invoked only after the final closed-eight-second snapshot and is reported separately.
method.guard: Stop only owned Chrome when its observed RSS sum exceeds3GiB; preserve partial observations, do not silently reduce workload or claim complete comparison.
method.source: Embedded production assets only, no routes/source overrides. Identical scalar-only observer; no retained full document/event copies.
method.exclusions: No Swift native wrapper or WebKit XPCs launched. No actual provider inference, PTY or tunnel.
